notes.title: Liminal Department 1.1.2 - VHS Tape Mode Update
notes.content:
Hello anomaly hunters and liminal space enthusiasts! Today [b]Liminal Department[/b] is getting a new content update, including new game mode, new anomalies, achievements and features!

[h1]VHS TAPE MODE[/h1]

VHS tape style camera with zooming feature. Also including a timer with minutes and seconds, calculating the game time. The new mode can be found under the [b]gameplay tab[/b] in settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45362954/55eda38ff604a65eb034c8913e2fe615a7f69f5f.png[/img]

[h1]NEW ANOMALIES[/h1]

Added 5 new anomalies, one for each type: "Basic"(Missing, Moved or Deformed object(s)), "Lighting", "Additional Artifacts" and "Supernational Activity".

[h1]LOOP RESET[/h1]

Made some changes on loop reset. You can now go back when the loop is reset and search for what has been missed, with the anomaly prompt, indicating the type of the anomaly/anomalies.

[h1]NEW ACHIEVEMENTS[/h1]

Added 2 more achievements, adding up to total of 10 steam achievements.

[h3]YOUTUBE VIDEO:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=edSyUOb8J4U;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Liminal Department is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello liminal space and observation games enthusiasts! Liminal Department is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45362954/173916992746d70c830bd36a319ee8ab5cfc40c0.gif[/img]

[h3]What is Liminal Department?[/h3]
Liminal Department is a psychological horror observation game with a liminal aesthetics that takes place in a hospital department. Inspired by Exit 8 and liminal spaces.

[h3]Game summary:[/h3]
Trapped in what seems to be an endless hospital department. Carefully observe your surroundings in each loop to escape the Liminal Department
Explore an ever-changing hallway filled with unusual occurrences. Each loop could have multiple anomalies or none. Some are easy to spot, others are not. After a careful examination submit for anomalies to proceed further. Memory skills are key to breaking the loop. Caught in a never-ending loop, leaving the department only leads you right back into the same hallway.

[h3]Key features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Realistic and eerie atmosphere with minimal UI
[*] More than 60 unique anomalies
[*] Head bobbing
[*] Full remappable keys
[*] Full controller support
[*] Variety of settings to tweak
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45362954/7a1caa0174d08cdd06afb78599468218a12af97c.png[/img]
